title: OrganizationType
description: Information to identify and reference a specific legal organization.

taxId.title: IdentifierType
taxId.description: A government assigned identifier to distinguish an organization. This typically is a country-level tax code. For example, Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) in the USA.

schemeId.description: The identification of the identifier scheme.

schemeVersionId.description: The identification of the version of the identifier scheme.

schemeAgencyId.description: The identification of the agency that manages the identifier scheme.

schemeLink.description: The URI that identifies where the identification scheme data is located.

agencyUri.description: The URI that identifies where the identification scheme is located.

formerTaxId.description: The former government assigned identifier to distinguish organization. This typically is a country-level tax code. For example, Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) in the USA.

legalId.description: An identifier of the organization for legal purposes. This could be a company, state, or other kind of identifier. For example, Data Universal Numbering System, abbreviated as DUNS.

items.title: CodeType
items.description: A code is a character string of letters, numbers, special characters (except escape sequences), and symbols. It represents a definitive value, a method, or a property description in an abbreviated or language-independent form that is part of a finite list of allowed values. Use this schema when there is a defined list of values but the owner is unknown or private, the values may not be referenced, or there is no validation possible.

industryIdentifiers.description: The types of industry to which the organization belongs. The Industry identifiers could be referenced to a standard taxonomy (such as NAICS) or a custom taxonomy.

headCount.title: NumberType
headCount.description: The number of employees in the organization. Depending on the organization, this could include full-time, part-time and contractors.

revenue.title: AmountType
revenue.description: The amount of revenue of the organization, typically from the most recent fiscal year.

currency.title: CurrencyCodeList
enumNames: Bond Markets Unit European Composite Unit (EURCO)
Bond Markets Unit European Monetary Unit (E.M.U.-6)

description.title: TextType
description.description: A description or quick summary of the organization.

languageCode.title: LanguageCodeList
enumNames: Church Slavic; Old Slavonic; Church Slavonic; Old Bulgarian; Old Church Slavonic
Macedonian, Macedonia (Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia)
Mongolian (Traditional Mongolian), People's Republic of China

geographicResponsibilityCode.title: GeographicResponsibilityCodeList
geographicResponsibilityCode.description: A code that classifies the geographic level at which the organization operates.

ownershipType.title: OwnershipTypeCodeList
ownershipType.description: A code that classifies the ownership of the organization.

organizationActivity.description: A description of the business activities conducted at the organization, listed by approximate percentage of revenue or sales associated with each activity.

items.title: OrganizationActivityType
items.description: The business activities conducted at the establishment.

description.description: A description of the organization activities.

percentage.title: PercentType
percentage.description: The percentage the entity spends on the activity.

stockSymbol.description: The stock symbol for the organization. The stock exchange symbol should also be included. Example: NYSE:XOM representing Exxon Mobile on the New York Stock Exchange.

workEnvironmentCode.description: A code to represent the working environment of the organization. E.g., Office, Workshop, Factory, etc.

contacts.description: Specific people at the organization who are contacts.

items.title: SpecifiedPersonType
items.description: Contains information to identify a person associated with the interaction or entity.

allOf.title: PersonReferenceType
allOf.description: A schema to reference to a person.

id.title: IdentifierType
id.description: An identifier is a character string used to uniquely identify one instance of an object within an identification scheme that is managed by an agency. Use this type when the list or values are controlled by an external entity, the list or values are public and could be referenced or validated.

schemeId.description: The identification of the identifier scheme.

schemeVersionId.description: The identification of the version of the identifier scheme.

schemeAgencyId.description: The identification of the agency that manages the identifier scheme.

schemeLink.description: The URI that identifies where the identification scheme data is located.

agencyUri.description: The URI that identifies where the identification scheme is located.

name.title: PersonNameType
name.description: A component for capturing summary or fine-grain data comprising a person's name.

allOf.title: LocalizationInclusion
allOf.description: Can be used for any entity to specify localization language code.

formattedName.description: The formatted name of a person, as it would be written out together (for example, on a mailing label).

legal.description: The legal name of a person (typically used if it differs from family name).

given.description: The given name of a person.

preferred.description: The preferred name of a person (if it differs from given name).

middle.description: The middle names or initials of a person.

family.description: The family name (or surname) of a person.

familyPrefix.description: The prefix of a family name, e.g. van der, de jong.

alias.description: An alias or (or also known as) name of a person.

formerFamily.description: The former family name of a person (used if the person's name was changed).

formerFamilyPrefix.description: The prefix of the former family name, e.g. van der, de jong.

preferredSalutationCode.title: CodeType
preferredSalutationCode.description: The salutation used to address a person (such as Dr., Mr., Mrs.).

generationAffixCode.description: The generational designation attached to the end of a person's name (such as Jr., Sr., II, III).

qualificationAffixCode.description: The professional designation attached to the end of a person's name (such as M.Sc., Ph.D).

titleAffixCode.description: The title designation attached to the end of a person's name (such as Esq., K.B.E.).

script.description: Script used to represent the name.

communication.title: CommunicationType
communication.description: Allows capture of information about a variety of communication channels (telephone, email, fax, messaging, address, etc.).

address.title: AddressTypeArray
address.description: An array of the address, which is the physical or mailing address of the entity.

allOf.title: AddressType
allOf.description: The physical or mailing address of the entity. This may include the street and building number, city, region (state, province, etc), country and postal code.

typeCode.description: The type of address, for example, business or home.

extendedLines.description: Extended address components (e.g. apartment or suite number).

type.description: Specify purpose of this extension (province, secondary line, house number, etc).

countryCode.title: CountryCodeList
countryCode.description: Two letter country codes as defined by ISO 3166-1:2013. Content referenced from Wikipedia.
enumNames: CONGO, THE DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF THE
SOUTH GEORGIA AND THE SOUTH SANDWICH ISLANDS
MACEDONIA, THE FORMER YUGOSLAV REPUBLIC OF

countrySubDivisions.description: Qualifies the further divisions of the Country. These may be Districts, Regions, States, Provinces etc.

latitude.description: The latitude of the geographical location.

longitude.description: The longitude of the geographical location.

altitude.title: MeasureType
altitude.description: The altitude of the geographical location. Defaults to meters above sea level in case no unitCode provided.

value.description: The numeric value of the measure.

name.description: The label of the geo coordinates.
Provide description for particular communication item.

useCode.description: Code identifying the usage of the contact point e.g. business, private, etc.

preference.description: Provide priority for given communication item.

availablePeriod.title: DateTimePeriodType
availablePeriod.description: Single period between date/times. Both start and end are required.

allOf.title: DateTimeOpenEndPeriodType
allOf.description: Single period between date/times. The end date/time is optional and should be used in cases where the end of the period is unknown or uncertain.

phone.title: PhoneTypeArray
phone.description: An array of the phone numbers of the entity.

countryDialingCode.description: The country dialing code for a communication number.

areaDialingCode.description: The area dialing code for a communication number.

dialNumber.description: The communication number, not including country dialing or area dialing codes.

phoneExtension.description: The extension of the associated communication number.

access.description: The text that permits access to the electronic network of the associated communication number such as telephone network, for example 9, *70.

formattedNumber.description: Specifies details of an actual formatted number.

email.title: EmailTypeArray
email.description: An array of the email addresses of the entity.

web.title: WebTypeArray
web.description: An array of the web sites or web addresses of the entity.

social.title: SocialTypeArray
social.description: An array of the social media handles or identifiers of the entity.

allOf.title: SocialType
allOf.description: The entity's unique social network URL which is a place where the person can be reached.

handle.description: The handle or identifier of the entity on the social network.

url.description: The fully qualified web address of the entity on the social network

tradeName.description: Trade name of the organizationor doing-business-as (DBA).

status.title: StatusType
status.description: The current operational status of the organization; e.g., open, temporarily closed, permanently closed, sold.

statusDate.title: DateType
statusDate.description: The date on which the status changed.

statusHistory.description: A history of the organization statuses; e.g., the date and code. e.g., sold, temporarily closed, permanently closed, merged, acquired, etc.

domainName.description: The internet domain to help identify the organization and a reference to find additional information.

parentCompanyTaxId.description: The tax ID of the parent company if this company is a wholly owned subsidiary of another company.

parentCompanyName.description: The legal name of the parent company if this company is a wholly owned subsidiary of another company.

parentOrganization.title: OrganizationReferenceType
parentOrganization.description: The parent organization of this organization as recognizaed in a roll-up relationship of organizations in the role of organization units in an organization hierarchy.

ResponsibilityCodeList.description: Values that classify the level or the responsibility at which the organization operates.
